verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents how flag changes reach connected SDKs. There is no mention of real-time streaming, polling intervals, or propagation latency. The kill-switch line (flagsmith-docs-50) only says a feature can be disabled, not how fast SDKs see the change. The Edge Proxy local cache and the community comparison favoring another tool for 'live data updates' are adjacent at best and do not show Flagsmith delivers seconds-level propagation.

support.subject: As a developer, flag changes propagate to connected SDKs in seconds via streaming or fast polling — a kill switch actually kills
